jobs.description:
Company

Providence at Home with Compassus

Schedule: 8m - 5pm, Monday - Friday with 2 weekend shifts per month

Territory:
Yorba Linda, Anaheim Hills, Placentia, and parts of Fullerton

Position Summary

The Registered Nurse plans, organizes and directs Hospice care and is experienced in nursing, with an emphasis on community health education / experience. The Hospice nurse builds from the resources of the Interdisciplinary Group (IDG) to plan and direct services to meet the needs of individuals and families within their home environments. May provide patient care to premature infants, infants, pediatrics, adolescents, young, middle and older adults.

Position Specific Responsibilities

Completes comprehensive assessments of patients and families to determine hospice needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
Develops, initiates, and revises individualized Plans of Care in collaboration with the IDG, using health assessment data to determine nursing diagnoses and establish goals.
Provides professional nursing care by utilizing the nursing process, implementing palliative interventions, administering prescribed medications and treatments, and counseling patients and families on health care needs.
Provides health care instructions to patients and families as appropriate per assessment and plan.
Coordinates with the Patient Care Manager and IDG to ensure continuity of care, safe environments, and support for the emotional needs of patients and caregivers.
Completes, maintains, and submits accurate and timely clinical documentation, including patient condition, care provided, and pain/symptom management outcomes.
Communicates patient needs, condition changes, and physician orders to the IDG and supervisors; attends IDG meetings to review and update Plans of Care.
Fulfills accepted case assignments, participates in on‑call duties, and maintains productivity standards per organizational guidelines.
Supervises and delegates responsibilities to ancillary personnel as appropriate.
Supports the orientation, education, and development of team members, and provides input on CHHA performance and assignments.
Assumes responsibility for professional growth through continuing education, in‑service programs, and other activities to enhance job‑related skills and abilities.
Actively participates in performance improvement initiatives and adheres to the Corporate Integrity Plan.
Ensures financial prudence in care delivery by coordinating medications, supplies, equipment, and other necessary services defined in the Plan of Care.

Education And/or Experience

Education requirements noted separately with each state.
California (CA)
Required: Education sufficient to meet certification, licensure, or registration requirements.
Preferred: 1 year of recent experience in hospice, palliative care, home health, acute care, and/or skilled nursing as a registered nurse.

Mathematical Skills: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
Language Skills: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from leaders, team members, investors, and external parties. Strong written and verbal communications.
Ability to understand, read, write, and speak English. Articulates and embraces integrated healthcare at home philosophy.
Other Skills and Abilities: Excellent observation, verbal and written communication, problem solving and basic math skills.
Visual acuity and hearing to perform required nursing skills.
Preferred working knowledge with computer applications, i.e. Microsoft Word/e-mail.

Certifications, Licenses, and Registrations

Required within 30 days of hire: National Provider BLS – American Heart Association (Vendor Managed)
Active state RN license (Vendor Managed).

Other

The demands of this role necessitate a team member to effectively perform essential functions. Adaptations can be made to accommodate team members with disabilities. Regular standing, walking, and manual dexterity are fundamental, along with the ability to lift and move objects up to 50 pounds. Visual acuity requirements include close and distance vision, color and peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. In a healthcare setting, exposure to bodily fluids, infectious diseases, and conditions typical to the field is expected. We are seeking a Program Manager to join Meta's Global Product Quality (GPQ) team and drive localization testing programs. This role is responsible for helping Meta's product teams validate how well their products perform linguistically and functionally across international markets, covering localization testing for AI-powered products, automated test execution, and locale-specific quality validation. You will manage vendor partnerships, design testing methodologies, and work with product, engineering, and i18n teams to turn test results into actionable recommendations. The role requires someone comfortable working collaboratively across a shared portfolio, applying automation to improve how testing gets delivered and reported, and operating across multiple product lines and geographies, prioritizing work based on impact and delivery timelines.

Program Manager, Localization Testing Responsibilities:

Own and operate the localization testing program, defining strategy, coverage models, and quality standards for validating translations and locale-specific product experiences across Meta's product portfolio
Rethink localization testing for an AI-native world: design and implement automation frameworks that leverage LLMs, AI-powered evaluation, and intelligent test generation to dramatically increase coverage and reduce manual effort
Drive in-market localization testing for AI-powered products (e.g., Meta AI), coordinating test design, locale coverage, and delivery timelines to support product launches
Manage vendor relationships, budgets, and compliance across localization testing partners, including scoping, performance management, and procurement coordination
Partner with product, engineering, and i18n teams to translate localization testing results into actionable product recommendations, ensuring issues are triaged, prioritized, and resolved
Build and maintain shared program infrastructure: automated test pipelines, testing methodology standards, bug taxonomy, severity frameworks, and deliverable templates used across localization testing
Define and track program metrics that demonstrate localization quality, test coverage, automation rates, and operational health of the localization testing program, reporting progress to i18n leadership
Collaborate closely with the broader international testing team to align on shared tooling, processes, and cross-program dependencies while maintaining full ownership of the localization testing workstream

Minimum Qualifications:

8+ years of experience in program management, QA/testing operations, localization, or a related field
Experience managing localization testing, QA, or internationalization programs that involve external vendor partners at scale
Experience working with product and engineering teams to translate testing findings into product decisions and quality improvements
Experience with international markets, localization workflows, or global product operations
Experience designing scalable processes, defining metrics, and driving continuous improvement across a testing program

Preferred Qualifications:

Background in presenting program outcomes and recommendations to product and engineering leadership
Familiarity with localization tooling ecosystems (TMS, CAT tools, pseudo-localization, string extraction pipelines)
Experience testing AI-powered or generative AI products across multiple languages and locales
Experience managing vendor budgets and contracts, including compliance with contingent workforce policies
Experience building or implementing automation for localization testing or QA workflows (e.g., automated linguistic checks, AI-powered test generation, continuous localization validation)
Experience applying AI/ML or LLMs to improve testing coverage, efficiency, or quality evaluation

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. We are seeking a Program Manager to join Meta's Global Product Quality (GPQ) team and drive localization testing programs. This role is responsible for helping Meta's product teams validate how well their products perform linguistically and functionally across international markets, covering localization testing for AI-powered products, automated test execution, and locale-specific quality validation. You will manage vendor partnerships, design testing methodologies, and work with product, engineering, and i18n teams to turn test results into actionable recommendations. The role requires someone comfortable working collaboratively across a shared portfolio, applying automation to improve how testing gets delivered and reported, and operating across multiple product lines and geographies, prioritizing work based on impact and delivery timelines.

Program Manager, Localization Testing Responsibilities:

Own and operate the localization testing program, defining strategy, coverage models, and quality standards for validating translations and locale-specific product experiences across Meta's product portfolio
Rethink localization testing for an AI-native world: design and implement automation frameworks that leverage LLMs, AI-powered evaluation, and intelligent test generation to dramatically increase coverage and reduce manual effort
Drive in-market localization testing for AI-powered products (e.g., Meta AI), coordinating test design, locale coverage, and delivery timelines to support product launches
Manage vendor relationships, budgets, and compliance across localization testing partners, including scoping, performance management, and procurement coordination
Partner with product, engineering, and i18n teams to translate localization testing results into actionable product recommendations, ensuring issues are triaged, prioritized, and resolved
Build and maintain shared program infrastructure: automated test pipelines, testing methodology standards, bug taxonomy, severity frameworks, and deliverable templates used across localization testing
Define and track program metrics that demonstrate localization quality, test coverage, automation rates, and operational health of the localization testing program, reporting progress to i18n leadership
Collaborate closely with the broader international testing team to align on shared tooling, processes, and cross-program dependencies while maintaining full ownership of the localization testing workstream

Minimum Qualifications:

8+ years of experience in program management, QA/testing operations, localization, or a related field
Experience managing localization testing, QA, or internationalization programs that involve external vendor partners at scale
Experience working with product and engineering teams to translate testing findings into product decisions and quality improvements
Experience with international markets, localization workflows, or global product operations
Experience designing scalable processes, defining metrics, and driving continuous improvement across a testing program

Background in presenting program outcomes and recommendations to product and engineering leadership
Familiarity with localization tooling ecosystems (TMS, CAT tools, pseudo-localization, string extraction pipelines)
Experience testing AI-powered or generative AI products across multiple languages and locales
Experience managing vendor budgets and contracts, including compliance with contingent workforce policies
Experience building or implementing automation for localization testing or QA workflows (e.g., automated linguistic checks, AI-powered test generation, continuous localization validation)

Position Overview

We are seeking a Program Manager to join Autodesk's Emerging Business Operations team, reporting directly to the Manager, M&A Operations. This role is integral to our mission of helping newly acquired or incubated businesses transition into high-functioning, scalable operations. The Program Manager will own and drive cross-functional programs that support early-stage Go-To-Market integration and operational readiness for emerging businesses.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role for someone who excels at building programs from the ground up, managing multiple workstreams simultaneously, and influencing without direct authority. The ideal candidate brings strong program management discipline, GTM operations knowledge, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with structured thinking.

Responsibilities

Build and manage comprehensive integration programs from scratch, defining scope, goals, program plans, and communication methodology for new acquisitions or incubations
Define, oversee, and coordinate a set of interdependent projects sequenced to achieve combined GTM and operational outcomes
Align program and project management workstreams across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to achieve coordinated delivery
Manage multiple concurrent projects and programs, consistently demonstrating the ability to influence without direct authority
Track, influence, and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, sharing the 'why' behind requests and influencing with data
Communicate program details to both internal and external audiences in a variety of formats, including executive summaries
Navigate difficult stakeholder conversations and potential conflicts through effective communication
Gather regular feedback and take appropriate action to keep programs on track
Analyze trends, monitor progress, and report on measurable results against program objectives
Anticipate risks with accuracy and develop mitigation strategies; generate multiple response options with costs, benefits, and feasibility
Manage escalations effectively and in a timely manner
Define unique and complex program management approaches, standards, and processes tailored to each acquisition's integration requirements
Contribute to the M&A operational playbook, capturing lessons learned and best practices from each program
Incorporate change management principles into program design and execution

Minimum Qualifications

5+ years of experience in program or project management, GTM operations, strategy consulting, or M&A integration in a SaaS or technology environment
Demonstrated ability to build and manage programs from scratch, including defining scope, assembling workstreams, and driving end-to-end delivery
Strong understanding of all facets of Sales or Revenue Operations in a SaaS based company
Strong understanding of Go-To-Market functions including sales planning, marketing programs, and customer success workflows
Proven ability to manage ambiguity and drive forward progress on multiple initiatives simultaneously
Excellent stakeholder communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging across audiences and levels
Experience using data to evaluate program performance, analyze trends, and support decision-making

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in M&A integration programs, from deal closure through post-close execution
Background in change management and the ability to incorporate change strategy into program design
Familiarity with Autodesk GTM systems and processes (Salesforce, CPQ, ERP, Q2C)
Experience with a variety of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Kanban) and tools (Asana, Airtable, MS Project, etc.)
Background in management consulting or operational transformation
